metadata.title: Safety Tips | Open Market
metadata.description: Stay safe when buying and selling on Open Market.

safety.title: Safety Tips
safety.intro: At Open Market, your safety is our top priority. While most transactions go smoothly, it's important to stay vigilant. Here are some guidelines to help you buy and sell safely.
safety.tip1Body: Always arrange to meet in a busy, public location like a coffee shop, shopping mall, or police station "safe exchange zone". Avoid meeting at your home or a secluded area, especially for high-value items.
safety.tip2Body: If possible, bring a friend or family member with you to the exchange. There is safety in numbers. If you must go alone, let someone know where you are going and who you are meeting.
safety.tip3Body: Examine the item thoroughly before handing over any money. Ensure it matches the description and works as expected. Don't be pressured into a quick sale.
safety.tip4Body: Unlike other platforms, Open Market connects you to real Atmosphere profiles. Click the seller's handle to see their activity. Do they have followers? Have they been active for a while? Reputation is your best safety tool.
safety.reportBody: If you encounter a suspicious listing or user, please report it to us immediately using the "Report Listing" feature or contacting us directly.

sellerGuide.title: Seller Guide
sellerGuide.intro: Ready to declutter and earn some extra cash? Follow these best practices to create listings that attract buyers and sell quickly on Open Market.
sellerGuide.photosTip2: Take photos from multiple angles (front, back, sides).
sellerGuide.photosTip3: Show any defects or wear honestly.
sellerGuide.descTip1: Be descriptive in your title (brand, model, size).
sellerGuide.descTip3: Mention why you are selling it.
sellerGuide.descTip4: Use keywords buyers might search for.
sellerGuide.priceTip1: Research similar items to see what they sold for.
sellerGuide.priceTip2: Be willing to negotiate reasonable offers.
sellerGuide.priceTip3: Consider pricing slightly lower for a quick sale.
sellerGuide.priceTip4: Mark items as "Free" if you just want them gone!
sellerGuide.commTip1: Respond to messages as quickly as you can.
sellerGuide.commTip3: Clearly state your availability for meeting up.
sellerGuide.commTip4: Mark items as "Sold" immediately after the sale.

metadata.title: Privacy Policy | Open Market
metadata.description: How Open Market handles your data.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introBoxTitle: Your listings live on your own PDS — not our servers.
privacyPolicy.introBoxBody: Because Open Market is built on the AT Protocol, the content you publish stays on your own Personal Data Server. We index it for discovery, but we don't own it and can't hold it hostage.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: This Privacy Policy describes how Open Market collects, uses, and protects information. Most of your data — including your listings — lives on your own Personal Data Server (PDS), not ours.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.notCollectedItems: AT Protocol password, payment details, private messages, PDS data beyond public records
collection.collectedItems: Atmosphere handle/DID (via OAuth), session tokens, analytics, support emails
collection.identityBody: We never receive your password. OAuth tokens are stored in your browser, not our servers.
collection.listingsBody: Listings are published as public ATProto records to your PDS. We only index them to power the marketplace.
collection.analyticsBody: We use Google Analytics to understand service usage. This data is aggregated and doesn't identify you personally.

usage.title: How We Use Information
usage.operatingBody: To authenticate you and display your storefront to others.
usage.improvementBody: Analytics help us decide which features to build next.
usage.supportBody: To respond to your inquiries and troubleshoot issues.

storage.title: Data Storage & Security
storage.listingsBody: Stored on the AT Protocol network via your PDS. Removing a listing de-indexes it from Open Market.
storage.sessionsBody: Stored in your browser and never held by our servers.
storage.operationalBody: Analytics and logs are stored on secure, encrypted servers.

rights.title: Your Rights & Choices
rights.accessBody: You can request your data or delete listings directly from your Atmosphere account.
rights.revokeBody: You can revoke OAuth access at any time from your Atmosphere settings.

cookies.title: Cookies & Tracking
cookies.body: We use essential cookies for sessions. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

association.title: AT Protocol Association
association.body: Open Market is an independent platform built on the AT Protocol. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Bluesky Social, PBC.

changes.title: Changes & Contact
changes.body: We may update this policy. Contact us at support@openmkt.app for inquiries.

privacyPolicy.questionsBody: We're committed to transparency. If anything here is unclear, just ask.

listings.title: Listings & Responsibility

transactions.title: Transactions & Payments
transactions.body: Open Market is NOT a party to any transaction. Payments and shipping are between buyer and seller.

dependency.title: AT Protocol Dependency

metadata.title: What is Open Market? | The Open Web Marketplace
metadata.description: Learn how Open Market is reclaiming commerce for the community on the AT Protocol.

hero.title: The Marketplace for the
hero.subtitle: Turn your Atmosphere profile into a storefront.
hero.subtitleHighlight: Zero fees. No lock-in. 100% owned by you.

theWhy.title: Social media is great for connection,
theWhy.description: You post a product, and the algorithm buries it. You build an audience, and the platform holds them hostage.
theWhy.solutionDesc: We built a decentralized marketplace directly on the AT Protocol. We don't "host" your shop, it's all yours—we just make it easier to find.

features.ownDataDesc: Your listings live in your personal repository (PDS), not just our database.
features.ownAudienceDesc: We don't use algorithms to hide your posts or shake you down for ads.
features.portableDesc: If you ever leave, you take your reputation, history, and listings with you.

forSellers.title: "I already have an Etsy/Shopify. Why do I need this?"
forSellers.subtitle: We aren't trying to replace your main shop—we are here to

storefront.title: The Atmosphere Storefront
storefront.desc: Turn your Atmosphere profile into a shop in one click. Give your social followers a place to buy instantly.

traffic.title: Traffic Engine
traffic.desc: Link your Open Market listings directly to your Etsy or Shopify checkout. Use us for discovery, them for fulfillment.

zeroFees.title: Zero Fees
zeroFees.desc: We don't charge listing fees or transaction fees. We verify, you sell. You keep 100% of the sale price.

forCommunity.title: Commerce feels human again.
forCommunity.subtitle: Remember when buying something meant talking to a person, not a bot?

local.title: Local Finds
local.desc: Discover furniture, gear, and collectibles in your actual neighborhood.

trust.title: Trusted Identity
trust.desc: See exactly who you are dealing with—their join date, their posts, and their reputation.

howItWorks.title: You already have an account.
howItWorks.subtitle: Because we are built on the {atproto}, you don't need to create a new profile. Your reputation travels with you.

step1.title: Log in with your Atmosphere account
step1.desc: We instantly fetch your avatar, banner, and handle. No new passwords to remember.

step2.title: List in Seconds
step2.desc: Snap a photo, add a description, and set your price. It's quick and easy.

online.title: Online Stores
online.desc: Link directly to your Etsy, Shopify, or Gumroad. We act as a traffic engine.

community.title: Community Sellers
community.desc: Arranging a local sale? Chat directly via DMs.

q1.a: No. Open Market is free to use. We are a community-built project dedicated to the Open Web.

q2.a: Open Market is built by a single developer, for the community. I believe in the vision of the AT Protocol and a user-owned internet.

q3.q: I already sell on Etsy. Why do I need this?
q3.a: Think of Open Market as your decentralized window display. It is a free discovery engine that puts your products in front of the Atmosphere community without them having to dig through a chaotic feed. We act as your top-of-funnel marketing, driving ready-to-buy traffic directly to your Etsy store at no cost.

q4.a: No. Open Market is a standard marketplace. We use the AT Protocol for data storage and identity, not for payments. You pay with cash, Venmo, or credit card (via the seller's external link).

q5.q: Do I have to create a new account?
q5.a: No! You simply log in with your existing Atmosphere account. Your profile, avatar, and banner come straight from your main account, we just display them in the app.
